failures.question: 每个月的订单量，以及相比上个月的变化量是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM 
        orders
    GROUP BY 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        order_count,
        LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_order_count,
        order_count - LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_from_previous_month
    FROM 
        monthly_orders
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    order_count,
    COALESCE(change_from_previous_month, 0) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM 
    monthly_changes
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 25;

failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
    current_year AS (
        SELECT 
            DATE_PART('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
            COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
        FROM orders
        WHERE DATE_PART('year', order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
        GROUP BY DATE_PART('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
    ),
    previous_year AS (
        SELECT 
            DATE_PART('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
            COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
        FROM orders
        WHERE DATE_PART('year', order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
        GROUP BY DATE_PART('month', order_purchase_timestamp)
    )
SELECT 
    c.month,
    c.order_count AS current_year_orders,
    p.order_count AS previous_year_orders,
    (c.order_count - p.order_count) AS growth
FROM current_year c
JOIN previous_year p ON c.month = p.month
ORDER BY c.month
LIMIT 12;

failures.question: 数据里最后 90 天，每周的商品销售额分别是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_timestamp
    FROM orders
), 
weekly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS week,
        SUM(oi.price) AS sales_without_freight
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (SELECT max_timestamp FROM max_date) - INTERVAL '90 days'

    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)

    week,
    sales_without_freight
FROM weekly_sales
ORDER BY week
LIMIT 14; -- 假设每周一条记录，90天大约14周，所以LIMIT 14
